findings.title: SEED-01 culprit NAMED: agent-error-capture.ts builds a shell command string from un-sanitized agent error output (escapes only " and \n), redirecting store_learning.py stdout into junk files like opc/400`
causal_links: caused-by same shell-string pattern as D5a-02
findings.observe_how: The quarantined junk artifact's content is verbatim store_learning.py stdout (`~ Learning skipped: noise_prefix: Agent '`). store_learning.py emits that EXACT string only when content begins with the prefix "Agent '" (NOISE_PREFIXES). The only code in the repo that builds content starting with "Agent '" is agent-error-capture.ts:144. agent-error-capture is registered PostToolUse:Task in active settings.json. When a Task agent's tool_response matches an ERROR_PATTERN, the hook execs a SHELL string (execSync runs through cmd.exe on Windows) interpolating the agent's raw error text, escaped only for double-quote and newline. Shell metacharacters in the agent output (backtick, >, <, |, &, ;) pass through live -> a `>` in the error text redirected store_learning.py's stdout into a file named by the adjacent token (e.g. `400` / `Safety` with a trailing backtick), creating the junk files. Re-confirm trigger via Task Scheduler shows no daily task spawns agents at 07:24 -> trigger is a logon-time interactive session (INFERRED); the call-site bug is the root cause (VERIFIED).
findings.telemetry: Count files matching ^opc/[^/]*`$ (junk artifacts); add a stderr canary when escapedContent contains any of ` $ ( ) > < | ; & before execSync.

findings.title: hook-error-pipeline.ts has the identical un-escaped execSync shell-string store_learning call (content = error message interpolated, escapes only " and \n) — same junk-creation + injection class as D5a-01
findings.observe_how: storeErrorAsLearning() (called by captureHookError, the shared error-capture wrapper) builds content=`Hook '<name>' failed with error: ${error.errorMessage}. Stack: ...` and execs a shell string with escapedContent escaping only " and \n. error.errorMessage is arbitrary thrown-error text (can contain backtick/>/$()), so the same stdout-redirect / command-substitution failure mode applies. Any junk file it produced would carry a 'Hook ' content prefix (store_learning skips that too -> 'noise_prefix: Hook '). Same fix as D5a-01: pass args as an array via spawnSync (no shell), matching the safe callers (periodic-extract/browser-learning-extractor/post-plan-roadmap/smarter-everyday).
findings.telemetry: Grep junk artifacts for content beginning 'Hook '; count captureHookError invocations where errorMessage contains shell metachars.

findings.title: user-confirmation-detector.ts (UserPromptSubmit hot path) passes the raw user prompt into an execSync shell:true command escaping only " — backtick/$()/;/> in a prompt reaches the shell (command injection + junk creation)
findings.observe_how: Two call sites build content embedding the user's verbatim prompt (`User confirmed: "${prompt}"`) and exec it with execSync({shell:true}), escaping only the double-quote (`.replace(/"/g, '\\"')`) — NOT backtick, $(), ;, &, > or %VAR%. This is a UserPromptSubmit hook so the prompt is fully user-controlled free text. A prompt containing a backtick or $(...) executes an arbitrary subcommand; a > redirects store_learning stdout to an attacker/user-named file. Same remediation: spawnSync with an args array, drop shell:true. (Note: on Windows the execSync shell is cmd.exe, where \" is NOT a valid quote-escape anyway, so even the one escape applied is ineffective — a literal " in a prompt breaks --content quoting regardless.)
findings.telemetry: Log when a prompt reaching storeUserConfirmedLearning/storeVictoryFromConfirmation contains shell metacharacters; count resulting non-zero store exits.

notes: D5a worklist summary. Junk-creator root cause for SEED-01 is NAMED with VERIFIED confidence: agent-error-capture.ts:176 — the only store_learning caller whose content begins with "Agent '", which is exactly the prefix in the quarantined junk artifact's stdout. Three vulnerable shell-string call sites total (agent-error-capture.ts, hook-error-pipeline.ts, user-confirmation-detector.ts ×2); all interpolate untrusted free text (agent output / thrown-error message / raw user prompt) into a shell command escaping at most " and \n. The four other store_learning callers use safe spawn-array form. Common fix: replace execSync(shellString) with spawnSync('uv', [...args], {shell:false}). Daily ~07:24 trigger is INFERRED (logon-time session; no scheduled task spawns Task agents) but does not change the call-site root cause. The harvest evidence files live under docs/reviews/ (excluded) so all cited evidence is from live source files (agent-error-capture.ts, hook-error-pipeline.ts, user-confirmation-detector.ts, store_learning.py). READ-ONLY review; no changes made.
